name: irmeeting-app
description: IrMeetingApp - tech meetup discovery platform (root orchestrator scripts)

scripts.setup: npm install && npm install --prefix backend && npm install --prefix frontend && npm install --prefix tests && npx --prefix tests playwright install chromium

scripts.test: npm run test:unit && npm run test:e2e
scripts.test:unit: npm run test --prefix backend && npm run test --prefix frontend
